evaluation_components.when: Announced 6 tests - best 5 will be considered for the final marks
Surprise test during lecture & tutorial class

attendance_policy: Weightage of 10% is assigned for assessment linked to attendance and participation, towards this component a small surprise-quizzes will be conducted in the lecture and tutorial class. Best 5 quizzes linked to attendance and participation will be considered in the final score. This score will be considered for the students having minimum attendance of 50%. For the students having attendance less than 50%, zero marks will be assigned irrespective of quizzes attempted.
makeup_policy: Make-up request for mid-semester examination is to be submitted 7 days in advance of the exam (or within 72 hrs in case of medical emergency). For comprehensive examination the request is to be made to AUGSD as per its guidelines. It is mandatory to submit the necessary supporting documents (such as: listed below) along with make-up request: o Letter of invitation/selection for a national/international event where the applicant is representing BITS Pilani. o Proof of hospitalization, medical certificate, prescription, medicine purchase bill, etc. The decision of granting make-up to the applicant is taken mutually by the team of course instructors and would be final in all such matters. There is no makeup for the tutorial as all the tutorial are announced and one tutorial in buffer.
